description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead our dedicated nursing team at a premier skilled nursing facility in Mediapolis, IA. This is an exceptional opportunity for a visionary leader to oversee all aspects of nursing care, ensuring the highest standards of quality and resident well-being.

The successful candidate will play a critical role in shaping our clinical environment, fostering a culture of excellence, and driving positive patient outcomes. We offer a competitive salary and a supportive work environment where your leadership will make a significant impact.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa.
Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in a leadership role within a skilled nursing or long-term care setting.
Demonstrated knowledge of state and federal regulations governing long-term care.
Strong clinical assessment, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication, interpersonal, and team-building abilities.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive annual salary ranging from $85,000 to $95,000, based on experience and qualifications.
